title: Exhaustion of an open set by compactly contained open sets
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ and every open set U ⊆ ℝ^P (= Eucl P) there is a sequence (W_i)_{i∈ℕ} of subsets of ℝ^P with two properties. (a) For every i, CompactlyContainedOpen W_i U holds: W_i is open, closure(W_i) is compact and closure(W_i) ⊆ U. (b) Every compact K ⊆ U is contained in W_i for some i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), (∀ i, CompactlyContainedOpen (W i) U) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ i, K ⊆ W i
